input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== REFERENCE ASSIGNMENT — STRICT ===

Use the provided references exactly as follows:

RIVEN reference = Riven.

ALLY SOLDIER reference = the specific allied male soldier Riven saves in this scene.

BATTLEFIELD reference = the physical battlefield environment.

Do not confuse ALLY SOLDIER with any background soldier.

Do not replace ALLY SOLDIER with another soldier.

Do not change the identity of RIVEN or ALLY SOLDIER during the scene.


=== CHARACTER LOCK — RIVEN ===

Use the provided RIVEN reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, and overall silhouette.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

Keep her original costume, hairstyle, armor, body proportions, and sword unchanged.

Riven is an experienced battlefield warrior.

She is fast, highly skilled, decisive, and accustomed to fighting inside a large battle.

Her movement should feel powerful, controlled, and practical.

Her sword remains intact throughout the entire scene.


=== CHARACTER LOCK — ALLY SOLDIER ===

Use the provided ALLY SOLDIER reference image as the strict primary character reference for the soldier Riven saves.

Preserve ALLY SOLDIER's recognizable facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, armor design, clothing, and overall appearance.

ALLY SOLDIER must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

He belongs to Riven's army.

He is a capable adult soldier.

He is not cowardly.

He is not helpless.

He becomes overwhelmed only because several enemy soldiers pressure him during the chaos of the battle.

ALLY SOLDIER is the specific person Riven notices, saves, and helps back onto his feet.

Keep his face recognizable because this same ALLY SOLDIER will appear with Riven again later.


=== BATTLEFIELD REFERENCE — IMPORTANT ===

Use the provided BATTLEFIELD reference image as the environmental reference.

Preserve the recognizable terrain, battlefield layout, landscape, structures, color palette, and overall environmental design.

IMPORTANT:

The BATTLEFIELD reference may appear empty, ruined, or like the aftermath of a battle.

DO NOT reproduce that empty state.

In this video, this exact location is currently in the middle of a massive ACTIVE WAR.

The BATTLEFIELD reference defines WHERE the scene takes place.

This prompt defines WHAT IS HAPPENING there.


=== ACTIVE WAR — CRITICAL ===

THIS IS AN ACTIVE LARGE-SCALE BATTLE.

The battle is happening RIGHT NOW.

From the FIRST FRAME until the END of the scene, many soldiers from TWO opposing armies are actively fighting across the battlefield.

The battlefield must NEVER look abandoned, empty, quiet, or like the aftermath of a battle.

There must be continuous visible warfare around RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER.

Soldiers clash with swords and weapons throughout the foreground, middle ground, and background.

Groups of soldiers push against each other.

Individual soldiers fight at close range.

Other soldiers rush through the battlefield to reinforce ongoing fights.

The two armies should feel like they are colliding across a large battlefield.

RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER are only two warriors inside this much larger war.

Do not isolate them in an empty environment.

Do not clear the battlefield around them.

Do not portray the battle as already finished.


=== BATTLEFIELD ATMOSPHERE ===

Create the atmosphere of a violent medieval fantasy war in progress.

Smoke moves across parts of the battlefield.

Small and medium fires burn in several areas.

Wooden structures and battlefield objects are burning.

Flames flicker visibly through the smoke.

Dust and dirt are kicked into the air by soldiers running and fighting.

Weapons clash.

Soldiers move rapidly through the environment.

The distant battlefield remains filled with active combat.

The environment should feel hot, loud, crowded, dangerous, and alive.

Fire and smoke are atmospheric elements of the ACTIVE battle, not evidence that the battle has already ended.

Maintain the same large-scale active-war atmosphere established in Scene 7.


=== ARMY CLARITY — STRICT ===

There are TWO clearly distinguishable armies fighting each other.

RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER belong to the SAME army.

Their allied soldiers fight beside and around them.

Enemy soldiers wear clearly different armor and equipment.

RIVEN attacks ONLY enemy soldiers.

ALLY SOLDIER attacks ONLY enemy soldiers.

Enemy soldiers attack RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER.

Allied soldiers never attack RIVEN.

Allied soldiers never attack ALLY SOLDIER.

RIVEN never attacks allied soldiers.

Do not confuse ALLY SOLDIER with an enemy.

Do not make RIVEN fight ALLY SOLDIER.

Both armies must remain visibly present throughout the scene.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

The entire scene has one simple narrative purpose:

ALLY SOLDIER becomes overwhelmed during the battle.

RIVEN notices that he is in immediate danger.

RIVEN rushes to help him.

RIVEN fights off the enemy soldiers threatening him.

RIVEN then pulls ALLY SOLDIER back onto his feet.

Keep this story visually simple and easy to understand.

Do not introduce another important character.

Do not create another subplot.

Do not turn this into another long Riven combat showcase.

The focus is the RESCUE.


=== OPENING — ALLY SOLDIER IN DANGER ===

START DIRECTLY IN ACTIVE COMBAT.

No establishing shot.

No walking introduction.

No preparation.

No quiet battlefield.

No empty battlefield shot.

The first moment immediately shows ALLY SOLDIER already fighting enemy soldiers while the large war rages around him.

ALLY SOLDIER fights competently.

However, several enemy soldiers pressure him during the chaos.

Do not over-choreograph the fight.

Keep the action natural, fast, and readable.

ALLY SOLDIER struggles to maintain control.

He is eventually knocked down onto the battlefield.

He remains conscious.

He tries to recover.

An enemy soldier moves toward the fallen ALLY SOLDIER while he is vulnerable.

The danger is immediate and visually obvious.

The larger battle continues at full intensity around him.


=== RIVEN NOTICES ===

RIVEN is fighting nearby inside the same active battle.

She is NOT standing still watching.

She is already participating in the war around her.

During the fighting, RIVEN notices ALLY SOLDIER on the ground with enemy soldiers closing in.

Make the visual connection clear:

RIVEN sees ALLY SOLDIER.

RIVEN immediately recognizes that he is in danger.

She reacts without hesitation.

RIVEN moves quickly through the nearby battle toward ALLY SOLDIER.


=== THE RESCUE ===

RIVEN reaches ALLY SOLDIER before the enemy can finish him.

She intercepts the immediate attack and protects ALLY SOLDIER.

RIVEN then engages the small group of enemy soldiers threatening him.

Keep this combat fast, intense, physical, and cinematic.

Do NOT choreograph every individual sword strike.

Allow the fight to flow naturally.

RIVEN uses experienced swordsmanship to take control of the immediate situation.

She blocks attacks, counters, repositions, and uses powerful sword strikes naturally as needed.

She may use short explosive movements and powerful sweeping attacks inspired by her recognizable fighting style.

Keep everything physically grounded.

No teleportation.

No flying.

No giant magical attacks.

No large supernatural energy effects.

Do not make this another extended combat showcase like Scene 7.

The combat exists to communicate one thing:

RIVEN IS FIGHTING TO PROTECT ALLY SOLDIER.

RIVEN successfully defeats or drives away the immediate enemy soldiers threatening ALLY SOLDIER.

The immediate rescue fight is now finished.


=== RIVEN HELPS ALLY SOLDIER ===

After the immediate threat is gone, RIVEN immediately turns back toward ALLY SOLDIER.

ALLY SOLDIER is still on the ground but conscious.

The larger war continues around them.

RIVEN approaches ALLY SOLDIER.

She reaches one hand down toward him.

ALLY SOLDIER looks up at RIVEN.

ALLY SOLDIER takes her hand.

RIVEN firmly pulls ALLY SOLDIER back onto his feet.

Make this physical interaction clear and readable.

Do not rush this specific moment.

Once ALLY SOLDIER is standing, RIVEN briefly checks him.

RIVEN asks naturally in English:

"You alright?"

ALLY SOLDIER catches his breath.

He gives a small nod.

ALLY SOLDIER answers naturally in English:

"Yeah."

No other dialogue.

No long conversation.

No dramatic gratitude.

No hug.

No emotional speech.

They are two soldiers communicating briefly in the middle of an ongoing war.


=== ENDING ===

The battlefield does NOT become quiet after the rescue.

The surrounding soldiers do NOT disappear.

RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER are NOT suddenly alone.

The war continues around them.

Soldiers continue fighting.

Troops continue running through the battlefield.

Weapons continue clashing.

Fires continue burning.

Smoke continues moving across the battlefield.

ALLY SOLDIER regains his balance.

He is able to stand and move normally.

He grips his weapon again.

RIVEN sees that he is alright.

RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER share one brief look of acknowledgment.

Then both turn their attention back toward the ongoing battle.

CUT.

Do NOT start another specific combat sequence before the cut.

The rescue has been completely resolved.


=== CAMERA ===

Use energetic cinematic battlefield cinematography consistent with Scene 7.

The camera should clearly communicate the rescue story.

At the beginning, keep ALLY SOLDIER recognizable while he fights and becomes overwhelmed.

When RIVEN notices him, make the relationship between their positions visually understandable.

Follow RIVEN dynamically as she moves toward ALLY SOLDIER.

During the rescue fight, keep the action readable rather than excessively chaotic.

When RIVEN reaches down and pulls ALLY SOLDIER onto his feet, use clearer and slightly calmer framing so the interaction is unmistakable.

However, the active war must remain visible behind and around them.

Do not frame RIVEN and ALLY SOLDIER against an empty background.

Other soldiers should still be visibly fighting deeper in the frame.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film large-scale battle quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Realistic sword combat.

Realistic weapon weight and physical impact.

Realistic cloth, hair, armor, fire, smoke, dust, and weapon physics.

Maintain strict RIVEN identity consistency.

Maintain strict ALLY SOLDIER identity consistency.

Maintain one consistent sword for RIVEN throughout the scene.

Keep the staging readable despite the large battle.

No exaggerated slow motion.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

All dialogue must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Clear natural English pronunciation.

Accurate visible lip synchronization.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No Japanese.

No Korean.

No other spoken language.

No additional dialogue.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

RIVEN successfully saved ALLY SOLDIER.

ALLY SOLDIER survived.

RIVEN personally pulled ALLY SOLDIER back onto his feet.

They have clearly interacted and acknowledged each other.

ALLY SOLDIER is tired and slightly battered but not seriously injured.

He can stand and move normally.

RIVEN is not seriously injured.

RIVEN's sword remains intact.

The larger battle is still ongoing.

The rescue action is completely finished.

Scene 9 does NOT need to continue this exact physical moment.

Scene 9 can take place later, after the battle has ended, with RIVEN and this SAME ALLY SOLDIER resting together.


=== CORE VISUAL IDEA ===

This must look like the SAME TYPE OF ACTIVE WAR established in Scene 7.

TWO ARMIES ARE ACTIVELY FIGHTING EVERYWHERE.

FIRES ARE BURNING.

SMOKE IS MOVING THROUGH THE BATTLEFIELD.

SOLDIERS ARE CONSTANTLY FIGHTING AND RUNNING AROUND THEM.

Inside this chaos:

ALLY SOLDIER is fighting.

ALLY SOLDIER becomes overwhelmed.

ALLY SOLDIER falls.

RIVEN sees him in danger.

RIVEN immediately rushes toward him.

RIVEN protects him.

RIVEN fights off the immediate enemies.

RIVEN reaches down.

ALLY SOLDIER takes her hand.

RIVEN pulls ALLY SOLDIER back onto his feet.

The war continues around them.

CUT.

The scene is about ONE simple thing:

RIVEN SEES ALLY SOLDIER IN DANGER AND SAVES HIM.
